__Detailed Explanation__ :- 

__
 
• The line MN is the mirror.
 
• The word [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e65a3871415c55316198678d7f415ee9141409cbe78b1351e845a9348b6f845.png] ends with [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0aeb8095a99eb87bff496bbfed94afe54ba7a543440916796412254640315b9.png] . So, the mirror image will start with [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eec5a4da5113b18eea42366ac9f2220311ea78f7ce0c1d1e990d70e557ab416d.png] → Option 2 is eliminated.
 
• The second last letter of the word is [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d874c4aa212c6299c1968bfbe88dc2cf19c6be6c3cbb7d273afd04457428c105.png] . So, the second letter in the mirror image will be [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cf0fc1c616165af31606d39286fbc855fdc739f6b226e1f9ebfd7f5c38a63a6.png] → Options 1, 4 are eliminated.

Hence, Option 3) is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• In a mirror image Left changes to rightand theright changes to leftwheretop and bottom remains the same.

 
• When placement of mirror not given, by default we will assume it in vertical direction.
 
• The starting letter word will be at last after the mirror image drawn with left changes to right and right changes to left.
